title: Replication code and data for "Weight Is Not Power: Designing Voting Rules for an Expanded BRICS"
description: Python script and data that reproduce every table, figure and robustness check in the paper. Data: World Bank World Development Indicators, accessed 15 October 2026. Version 1.1 adds Shapley–Shubik constraint tests, constraint-floor sensitivity, vote-compression exponents, the double-majority threshold family, the majority-of-members comparison and the comparison with consensus.
